trends.name: Iran Crisis & Oil Price Escalation
trends.summary: Iran deadline approaching with Trump potentially delaying Tuesday ultimatum for fifth time. Negotiations described as 'pessimistic' with US considering escalation targeting Iranian infrastructure. Oil futures rising sharply with SocGen projecting potential $200+ prices, directly impacting global growth and inflation.

trends.name: Chip Sector & Export Controls
trends.summary: ASML faces existential threat from proposed US export curbs targeting China market. Simultaneously, Broadcom surges on expanded Google and Anthropic AI chip deals, signaling divergent fortunes in semiconductor space. Market bifurcation between China-exposed and AI-positioned chipmakers.

trends.name: Healthcare Insurance Rally on Medicare Rates
trends.summary: Health insurers surge on better-than-expected Medicare Advantage rates for 2027, signaling margin expansion. This represents a major policy win improving sector profitability and investor confidence in healthcare infrastructure.

trends.name: PMI & Economic Slowdown Signals
trends.summary: Eurozone Composite PMI at 50.3 with Services PMI missing expectations at 50.5. Eurozone Sentix Investor Confidence crashes to -19.2 vs -8.0 estimate. Data signals significant economic deceleration in Europe amid Iran war energy cost concerns.

trends.name: Universal Music $64B Takeover Bid
trends.summary: Bill Ackman's Pershing Square launches $64 billion takeover proposal for Universal Music after long underperformance of his stake. Represents major activist push in entertainment sector with significant M&A implications.

trends.name: Japan's Stimulus & Fiscal Policy Shift
trends.summary: Japan passes historic $764 billion yearly budget for new fiscal year, signaling aggressive stimulus to combat deflation and support growth. Major macro shift with implications for yen, inflation expectations, and global growth dynamics.

trends.name: AI Uncertainty & Income Generation
trends.summary: QQQX and income-focused strategies positioned to benefit from current AI sector uncertainty. Market shift toward yield generation amid volatility as investors hedge AI narrative execution risk.

trends.name: Inflation Expectations & Rate Path
trends.summary: 1-year inflation swap rates at 3.24% amid growing focus on inflation metrics beyond TIPS breakeven. Fed rate path increasingly uncertain as geopolitical risks (Iran) and energy costs complicate disinflation narrative.

trends.name: Energy Transition & Copper Demand
trends.summary: Copper companies with grid expansion exposure positioned as EV infrastructure and renewable buildout accelerate. Mesabi Trust benefits from US logistics advantages in iron ore, signaling broader commodities recovery tied to energy transition capex.

trends.name: Geopolitical Risk Premium Expansion
trends.summary: IMF warns 'all roads lead to higher prices and slower growth' as Iran war destabilizes energy markets and global supply chains. Housing market disruption, LNG constraints, and industrial relocations signal broadening economic impact beyond oil.

trends.name: Tech Valuations Under Pressure
trends.summary: ServiceNow identified as potential 'generational entry point' amid valuation compression. Ubiquiti flagged as overvalued. Market bifurcation between growth/momentum stocks and cheaper value opportunities as rate uncertainty persists.

trends.name: Housing Affordability Crisis Deepens
trends.summary: Only 12% of Americans married with home by 30 in 2025 vs 52% in 1960. Iran war uncertainty disrupting spring housing market. Structural affordability crisis with geopolitical overlay creating demand destruction.
